guarantees.claim: When state_we is high and either crypt_i or crypt_o is high, in the next cycle state_q[s] must differ from its past value NumCyclesPerRound ago or from its past value 2*NumCyclesPerRound ago, unless (SecAllowForcingMasks && force_masks_i) or dec_key_gen_o is high.

When out_valid_o rises and crypt_o is high, in the next cycle state_o[s] must differ from $past(state_q[s], NumCyclesPerRound) or $past(state_q[s], NumCyclesPerRound) must differ from $past(state_q[s], 2*NumCyclesPerRound), unless (SecAllowForcingMasks && force_masks_i) or dec_key_gen_o is high.

uncertain_points.claim: If parameter NumCyclesPerRound is 0 or 1, the $past delays may be invalid or reference the same time step, potentially making the assertions vacuous or always true, which could hide masking share failures.
uncertain_points.risk: Masking share repetition could go undetected by the formal check, leading to security vulnerability.

uncertain_points.claim: The assertions may fail or be spuriously triggered during the first 2*NumCyclesPerRound cycles because $past values are not yet defined; formal verification may require additional assumptions or reset conditions.
uncertain_points.cond: during initialization or first few cycles
uncertain_points.risk: False formal failures could mask real issues or cause unnecessary debug.
